description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover that the library is used via #include 'code.c' — not a .h header — which is the primary proprietary trap. (2) Create gateway_main.c that includes code.c with double-quotes. (3) Call config_create() to instantiate the manager. (4) Call config_load_file(cm, 'config/gateway.cfg') to load the key=value config file — discovering the file already exists with mqtt.broker, mqtt.port, mqtt.tls, device.id but is MISSING poll.interval and retry.max. (5) Use config_get_string, config_get_int, config_get_bool with correct default fallback parameters (e.g., config_get_int(cm, 'poll.interval', 60)) for the missing keys. (6) Print all six values to stdout. (7) Call config_destroy(cm) at the end. (8) Compile WITHOUT -DCONFIG_DEMO (that flag enables the library's own main — using it would cause a linker error due to duplicate main). The output must show 10.42.0.1, 8883, GW-PROD-042 from the file, and 60/3 as defaults.
